# Mod's Engineering Mathematics

Mod's Engineering Mathematics is a Thai educational website by Teerawut Savangboon for Engineering Mathematics education.

Current focus:
The website currently focuses on Engineering Mathematics 1.

Completed teaching document topics:
- Vector Algebra
- Limits and Continuity
- Derivatives
- Applications of Derivatives
- Integrals
- Techniques of Integration
- Applications of Integrals
- Improper Integrals
- Numerical Integration

Content development plan:
These completed teaching documents are being converted into website lessons and parallel YouTube lecture videos.

Main audience:
- First-year engineering students
- Electrical engineering students
- Thai learners studying Engineering Mathematics
- Learners who want to connect calculus with engineering applications

Language:
Thai

Website:
https://modsengineeringmath.com/

YouTube:
https://www.youtube.com/@modsengineeringmath
